steps.title: rlbench scene · rlbench visual evidence · ground rlbench target
steps.code:
obs = primitives.call(name="observe_rlbench_scene", include_raw=False, prompt="close laptop lid")
print("observe ok:", obs.ok)
if obs.ok:
    print("keys:", list(obs.output.keys()))
    if "object_pose_evidence" in obs.output:
        ope = obs.output["object_pose_evidence"]
        print("ope keys:", list(ope.keys()))
        if "available_state_pose" in ope:
            asp = ope["available_state_pose"]
            print("gripper_pose:", asp.get("gripper_pose"))
            tlds = asp.get("task_low_dim_state", [])
            print("tlds len:", len(tlds))
            for i in range(0, len(tlds), 7):
                print(f"chunk {i//7}:", tlds[i : i + 7])

vis = primitives.call(
    name="inspect_rlbench_visual_evidence",
    camera_name="front",
    prompt="close laptop lid",
    query="laptop lid",
    target_name="laptop lid",
)
print("vis ok:", vis.ok)
if vis.ok:
    print("vis keys:", list(vis.output.keys()))
    print("evidence_refs:", vis.output.get("evidence_refs"))
    print("mask_candidates:", vis.output.get("mask_candidates"))
    print("pose_evidence:", vis.output.get("pose_evidence"))

gnd = primitives.call(
    name="ground_rlbench_target",
    evidence_refs=vis.output.get("evidence_refs") if vis.ok else None,
    query="laptop lid",
    target_name="laptop lid",
)
print("gnd ok:", gnd.ok)
if gnd.ok:
    print("gnd output:", gnd.output)

for i in range(29, len(tlds), 7):

steps.code:
def quat_rot(q, v):
    qx, qy, qz, qw = q
    # t = 2 * cross(q_vec, v)
    tx = 2.0 * (qy * v[2] - qz * v[1])
    ty = 2.0 * (qz * v[0] - qx * v[2])
    tz = 2.0 * (qx * v[1] - qy * v[0])
    # v' = v + qw * t + cross(q_vec, t)
    rx = v[0] + qw * tx + (qy * tz - qz * ty)
    ry = v[1] + qw * ty + (qz * tx - qx * tz)
    rz = v[2] + qw * tz + (qx * ty - qy * tx)
    return [round(rx, 3), round(ry, 3), round(rz, 3)]


gp = obs.output["object_pose_evidence"]["available_state_pose"]["gripper_pose"]
print("gripper axes: X=", quat_rot(gp[3:], [1, 0, 0]), "Y=", quat_rot(gp[3:], [0, 1, 0]), "Z=", quat_rot(gp[3:], [0, 0, 1]))
for idx in [0, 7, 14, 21, 29, 36, 43, 50, 57, 64]:
    chunk = tlds[idx : idx + 7]
    q = chunk[3:7]
    print(
        f"idx {idx:2d} pos={[round(x,3) for x in chunk[:3]]}: X={quat_rot(q, [1,0,0])} Y={quat_rot(q, [0,1,0])} Z={quat_rot(q, [0,0,1])}"
    )

steps.title: Inspect the observation and execute the next code cell.
record rlbench evidence · close rlbench gripper · move rlbench arm to
steps.code:
wp0 = [float(x) for x in tlds[43:50]]
wp1 = [float(x) for x in tlds[50:57]]
wp2 = [float(x) for x in tlds[57:64]]

ev_refs = gnd.output["selected"]["evidence"]["evidence_refs"]
primitives.call(name="record_rlbench_evidence", key="waypoints", value=[wp0, wp1, wp2])

res_close = primitives.call(name="close_rlbench_gripper", evidence_refs=ev_refs)
print("close ok:", res_close.ok)

res_wp0 = primitives.call(
    name="move_rlbench_arm_to",
    evidence_refs=ev_refs,
    target_name="laptop lid",
    target_pose=wp0,
)
print("wp0 ok:", res_wp0.ok)
if res_wp0.ok:
    st = res_wp0.output.get("observation", {}).get("state_fields", {})
    print("gripper_pose after wp0:", [round(x, 4) for x in st.get("gripper_pose", [])])
    tlds_after = st.get("task_low_dim_state", [])
    if len(tlds_after) > 28:
        print("joint after wp0:", tlds_after[28])

obs2 = primitives.call(name="observe_rlbench_scene", include_raw=False, prompt="close laptop lid")
if obs2.ok:
    asp2 = obs2.output["object_pose_evidence"]["available_state_pose"]
    print("gp after wp0:", [round(x, 4) for x in asp2["gripper_pose"]])
    print("gripper_open:", obs2.output.get("observation_summary", {}).get("state_fields", {}).get("gripper_open"))
    print("joint after wp0:", asp2["task_low_dim_state"][28])

# Close gripper if still open, then move to wp1 and wp2
res_c = primitives.call(name="close_rlbench_gripper", evidence_refs=ev_refs)
print("close_gripper:", res_c.ok)

res_wp1 = primitives.call(
    name="move_rlbench_arm_to",
    evidence_refs=ev_refs,
    target_name="laptop lid",
    target_pose=wp1,
)
print("wp1 ok:", res_wp1.ok)

res_wp2 = primitives.call(
    name="move_rlbench_arm_to",
    evidence_refs=ev_refs,
    target_name="laptop lid",
    target_pose=wp2,
)
print("wp2 ok:", res_wp2.ok)

obs3 = primitives.call(name="observe_rlbench_scene", include_raw=False, prompt="close laptop lid")
if obs3.ok:
    asp3 = obs3.output["object_pose_evidence"]["available_state_pose"]
    print("gp after wp2:", [round(x, 4) for x in asp3["gripper_pose"]])
    print("joint after wp2:", asp3["task_low_dim_state"][28])
